pages.text: The Grid is a block that allows you to view and manage items in your storage network. It provides a user interface to access all items stored in your network.

Features:$(li)View all items in your storage network$(li)Search and filter items$(li)Sort items by name, quantity, or ID$(li)Group similar items together$(li)Use Grid Filters to create custom views$(li)View item amounts and storage locations

To use the Grid:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to open the interface$(li)Use the search bar to find items$(li)Click items to take them out$(li)Use Grid Filters to customize your view
